wrong.why: drops the colon rule altogether: a drive path is no longer outside and a colon elsewhere is accepted with no answer at all
recognises a drive only at the very start of the pattern, so `{C:/,x}/**` (a drive inside an alternation, pinned by an existing test) gets the colon answer instead of the outside one
checks for a colon before it checks for an absolute or `..` path, so `/a:b` and `src/../a:b` are reported as a colon, not as outside
